mapper.select: SELECT r.role_id FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, password, user_type, ref_id, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT ref_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_type = #{userType} AND ref_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (user_id, password, user_type, ref_id, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{password}, #{userType}, #{refId}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
